summary.text: Sarita Austin is a Democratic state representative from the Chittenden-19 District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Sarita Austin, also known as Sarah, was born in Boston, Massachusetts, and lives in Vermont.
Austin earned a bachelor's degree from Windham College and a graduate degree in teacher education and school counseling from the University of Vermont.
Austin's career experience includes working as a teacher and school counselor.
Austin served on the Williston School Board and volunteered on the Williston Fire Department as an EMT.
In the 2023-2024 session, Austin served on the House Education Committee.
